tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system for an Australian restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, deployed on Azure.
Developed Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform across three services with JWT-based authentication, Joi-based validation, and a server-side proxy integrating a third-party market data API.
Created StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property rental platform using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js authentication with ownership-based authorization.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to apply for the Full Stack Developer Internship role at Unstop, as advertised. As an MCA student at PES University with practical experience developing and deploying full-stack web applications, I am eager to contribute to real-world projects. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings and featured role-based access control. Additionally, I delivered a Point of Sale system for a freelance client utilizing Angular, C# (ASP.NET backend concepts), and MS SQL Server deployed on Azure. My project portfolio further includes Zenvest and StaySphere, where I built full-stack applications leveraging Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and React-aligned architectures with secure authentication and robust request validation. I am enthusiastic about applying my technical background in Node.js, Express, and modern frontend frameworks to support your engineering team. Thank you for considering my application. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed

screening_answers.why_this_role: This role aligns directly with my background in full-stack development.
